text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Once again, Trainer! Happy New Year!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, it's the Classic 
division! Which means the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If we combine your guidance with the voice 
of destiny, I can become even stronger! 
Please lend me lots of your strength!
choice_data_list: Of course. But... where are we?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I have no idea! It's probably a deserted 
island!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...How on earth did things end up like 
this right from New Year's—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's make it a great year!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's it! We need to find a power spot! 
The voice of destiny is telling me so!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!! A power spot!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Things turning out like this was bound to 
happen all along.
choice_data_list:
(Nothing to be done about it, let's switch 
gears!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, my phone battery was 
dead. She probably hadn't brought hers in 
the first place. Which meant... if this 
really was an uninhabited island, we were 
in serious trouble.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'll be totally fine, don't 
worry!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You've got that anxious look on your face! 
Don't worry, just believe in me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny gave me a push, and 
here I am! If we just have fun, we'll be 
back before we know it!"
choice_data_list: (I ended up getting cheered up instead...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why! What kind of fun are you 
looking to have!?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny told me to listen to 
your idea. Tell me, please!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to prioritize Epiphaneia's 
feelings for now and find a way out while 
having fun, I looked around for something 
we could do—
choice_data_list:
Let's think it over while playing at the 
beach

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I saw a small mountain in the distance. 
While enjoying the trek up, standing on 
high ground should also help me get a 
clear view of the situation."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Understood!! Let's climb it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I've been waiting for you!
choice_data_list: Huh... Were you waiting for me?
Huh... Were you waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
See, it's a dead end here, right? 'Cause I 
thought you wouldn't be able to climb it, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A wave of deep emotion washes over my 
chest. She stopped so that I wouldn't push 
myself too hard. That's just the kind of 
girl Epiphaneia is—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right! Get on my shoulders! I'll lift you 
up!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Come on!! Get on right now!! Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Epiphaneia's momentum, I 
was effortlessly hoisted up onto her 
shoulders. She felt remarkably stable, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Just a little further, keep 
going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after this and that, climbing 
mountains, racing up and down hills 
following Epiphaneia's lead, they finally 
arrived at—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh! What a great view!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My thoughts still feel a bit jumbled. If I 
have some fun with the fallen coconuts, it 
might clear my head and spark a brilliant 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Coconuts! Sounds great, alright, let's 
find some!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Found it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, all I gotta do is 
smash the outer shell! The voice of 
destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, with Epiphaneia's power, she 
might crush it entirely. Naturally, 
though, it was too late to stop her—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oryah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I did it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I aimed right for the sweet spot, drove my 
fist in, twisted it, and voilà!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It was in my pocket! I got it at the 
convenience store yesterday and totally 
forgot it was in there!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Mmm♪ So sweet! Here, Trainer, have a drink 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a sip of the coconut Epiphaneia 
gave me. Its crisp, refreshing sweetness 
cleared my mind in an instant.
choice_data_list:
(...Right, let me try looking from up 
high.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh! What a great view!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we're on an island, there's no 
reason not to enjoy the ocean. However, 
the January cold made going in impossible, 
so we decided to play in the sand while 
looking out for ships.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After spending dozens of minutes together 
finding seashells and looking for 
ship-shaped silhouettes, the moment I 
looked away—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer! It's done!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I dub it: The Ruins!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âThere was a deep hole gaping in the 
sandy beach. At the bottom lay a multitude 
of seashells...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I dug my toes into the sandy beach, gave a 
big 'Hmph!' and shoveled it right up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, the shells weren't placed 
there; they seemed to have emerged after 
being buried. Things resembling fish and 
animal bones were peeking out...
choice_data_list: (Th-This... No way, is this a real ruin—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer? You look pale!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we enjoyed the beach to the fullest! 
Let's move!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll discreetly contact the proper 
authorities later...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh! What a great view!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The ocean breeze feels amazing too~! This 
place really is a power spot!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though all sorts of things happened... 
they were all experiences I could only 
share with her, and I felt fully recharged 
to start the new year.
choice_data_list:
(That said, I need to get out of here 
soon—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. Are the two of you... 
heading out on New Year's Day?
choice_data_list: Wait, did you two get stranded too...?!
Wait, did you two get stranded too...?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...S-Stranded? Um, this place is—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Just a park. —It's a park."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It wasn't a deserted island at all. A 
short walk from the seaside led straight 
to a familiar park...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain of it! This year is going to 
be the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Cheer for me in the Classics too, okay?! I 
definitely want to win!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...'Want to win', huh? —Not 'I will 
win'."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, Epiphaneia had always 
declared with absolute confidence, "I will 
win."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet now, with her newfound passion for 
racing itself... it felt as though she was 
getting a little too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's just race right now! I'll go 
round everyone up!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...You seem to be getting carried away.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As long as Epi-san can show what she's 
truly capable of, I'm sure everything will 
be just fine.
choice_data_list: You're right, if you can bring that out...
Yeah, if you can bring that out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Classic races, it's true 
that Epiphaneia's head is still a bit in 
the clouds. We'll need to fire her up at 
some point.
choice_data_list: ...Wait, I have to go after Epi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with the two of them— 
by the time I finally managed to keep 
Epiphaneia in check, it had turned 
completely into evening...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer, turn on the TV! The voice of 
destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, it's begun! Our special 
New Year's racing feature, Twinkle 
Lovers!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That program featured Umamusume who were 
expected to make great strides in this 
year's Twinkle Series. For instance—

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
""Last year's Triple Tiara winner, 
Gentildonna!""

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"She was also chosen as Horse Girl of the 
Year—the first Classic-tier Tiara 
Umamusume in history to do so. We eagerly 
look forward to seeing her great 
achievements this year as well!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"And we certainly can't forget this 
Umamusume! Last year's Classic Double 
Crown winner, Gold Ship!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"She always electrifies the racing world 
with her unique race tactics. What will 
she show us this year...? We can't wait to 
find out!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, moving on to our special 
feature on this year's Classics!”

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"‘Every year, the Umamusume put on heated 
battles. And this year, a multitude of 
dazzling talents have already stepped 
forward into the Classic campaign!’"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"First is the Asahi Hai FS winner, 
Logotype! If the Junior champion wins the 
Satsuki Sho, it will be the first such 
feat since Narita Brian!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"‘And the next one we'd like to introduce 
is— Epiphaneia!’"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh!!!! It's here!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"Having received the guidance of great 
Umamusume, she is now letting her 
overflowing talent shine bright. She is 
one of the top favorites for this year's 
Classics!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I have high hopes for the 
Derby! It is the premier Classic race 
after all, so the Derby-winning Umamusume 
should lead the generation—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...That's it, I'll be the 
standard-bearer! I'll become number one to 
everyone, and take hold of destiny—"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—If Epiphaneia wins the Derby, it will 
elevate the reputation of mentors like 
Cesario, opening up an even broader future 
for both of them."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Right... Their destinies can be 
expanded too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's—absolutely fantastic! Yeah, it'll 
be an amazing way to repay the favor!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! First, we win the Satsuki Sho, build 
up momentum—and head to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...I guess it really is tough, huh? 2,400 
meters...—"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...The Satsuki Sho. It has to be there, 
nowhere else. In order to make it in 
time...—"

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
“—So... you're closing up shop, huh? Even 
though the clocks you make are all so 
wonderful, mister...”

text_block_list.name: Watch Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, Logo-chan. But, you know, table 
clocks that take so much maintenance just 
aren't in style these days..."

text_block_list.name: Watch Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
""Looks like they're turning this place 
into apartments. Thanks for looking out 
for me all this time—""

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: ...I won't let it die out any more.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: —I will win, no matter what...!
